# Scope

Extended follow-up (EFU) of the HARMONY terlipressin cohort. The analytic
cohort is **n = 220**: patients in the locked master dataset
(`final_master_01282026.xlsx`, n = 243) who have an EFU record in the 13
site-submitted files under
`Extended Data Collection/Finalized Files/09SEP2026/` and a recorded
`efu_listingstatus`. The site files hold 222 rows; 221 match a master patient
and 220 of those have a listing status (see *Join QC*).

| Table | Cohort | Column (stratifier) | Rows |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 — Demographics | EFU patients | `efu_listingstatus` | Demographics, comorbidities, prior complications, admission / day-0 labs & scores, treatment, HRS response, RRT |
| 2 — EFU summary | EFU patients | `efu_listingstatus` | All EFU outcome fields |
| 3 — HRS reversal | Listed (`efu_listingstatus == 1`) | none (unstratified) | Route, albumin use, HRS response and reversal |
| 4a — Response factors | Listed (`efu_listingstatus == 1`) | `hrs_responders_cat_2` | Baseline / day-0 severity, RRT, EFU outcomes, ICU & discharge, adverse events |
| 4b — Response factors | Transplanted (`efu_lt == 1`) | `hrs_responders_cat_2` | Same rows, minus the constant `efu_lt` |
| S1 — EFU summary | EFU patients | `listed_transplant` | Superseded by Table 2; kept from the earlier request |

# Data Handling Notes

| Topic | Handling in this analysis |
|:--|:--|
| Study IDs | EFU files format Yale IDs as `YAL-00N`; the master uses `Yale-N`. Both sides are joined on a normalized key (upper-case prefix + integer). |
| Cohort size | **220**. The 13 site files hold 222 rows; one CCF row has an ID that is not in the locked master (→ 221) and one of those has no `efu_listingstatus` (→ 220). The 22 CSF master patients have no EFU file at all. Every n is computed, never hard-coded. |
| Day-0 MAP | `map_day0_avg` = mean of `map_terli_day0_time0..3` after recoding `0` (not measured) to `NA`. |
| Albumin during therapy | `albumintotal_terli_dayN` = grams given on day N; the requested `albumintotal_terli_dayX` row is the shared `total_albumin` (sum over days 0–13; nothing is recorded after `Discont_Day`). `alb_terli_dayN` is *serum* albumin and is not used. |
| Below-detection labs | One `efu_lttbili` value is a `<x.x` string; `readr::parse_number()` keeps the limit value. |
| Missing stratifier | The patient with no `efu_listingstatus` is excluded from Tables 1–4 (n = 220, and 84 / 63 in the listed and transplanted cohorts). Only Supplementary Table S1, which strata on `listed_transplant`, uses all 221. |

library(tableone)

# Load `master` (n = 243) and the shared helpers. `output = tempfile()` keeps

# Table Helper

Tables use the shared pipeline's `create_table_one()`:
`tableone::CreateTableOne()` → `print()` → `write.csv()`, with the same printed
matrix returned as a `knitr::kable()`, so the web table and the CSV are
identical. Conventions (tableone defaults, matching every earlier Table 1 CSV
in the registry): continuous variables as median [IQR] with the Kruskal-Wallis
rank-sum test (`test = nonnorm`; equivalent to Mann-Whitney for two groups);
categorical variables as n (%) with the chi-squared test (continuity-corrected
for 2 × 2). `Missing` is the percentage of the cohort with a missing value.

# EFU Data Import

Each site returned one CSV. All files share the same 42 columns
(`subjectid` + 41 EFU fields; see the *EFU Variables* page). The files
contain no dates — only REDCap-calculated day counts from the index
admission — so nothing patient-identifying is loaded beyond the study ID
used for the join.

```{r efu-import}
#| code-summary: "Show EFU import and ID normalization"
efu_dir <- "/Users/to909/Partners HealthCare Dropbox/Tianqi Ouyang/Extended Data Collection/Finalized Files/09SEP2026"

# Study IDs differ in formatting between REDCap exports (e.g. `YAL-003` in the
# EFU file vs `Yale-3` in the master). Normalize both sides to
# `<UPPERCASE PREFIX>-<integer>` before joining.
norm_id <- function(x) {
  x      <- str_trim(x)
  prefix <- toupper(str_extract(x, "^[A-Za-z]+"))
  prefix <- if_else(prefix == "YAL", "YALE", prefix)
  number <- as.integer(str_extract(x, "[0-9]+$"))
  paste0(prefix, "-", number)
}

# Field types from the EFU data dictionary
efu_yesno <- c(
  "codestatus", "efu_readmit", "efu_readmit_cirrhosiscomp", "efu_readmitaki",
  "efu_status", "efu_rrt", "efu_listingstatus", "efu_listing", "efu_lt",
  "efu_slkt", "efu_kal", "efu_ltrrt", "efu_90_rrt", "efu_90lt_rrt",
  "efu_180_rrt", "efu_180lt_rrt", "efu_1yr_rrt", "efu_1yrlt_rrt"
)
efu_numeric <- c(
  "efu_daysreadmit", "efu_readmitscr", "efu_dayslastencounter", "efu_daysdod",
  "efu_daysrrtstart", "efu_dayslisting", "efu_dayswlremoval", "efu_dayslt",
  "efu_dayskal", "efu_ltna", "efu_lttbili", "efu_ltscr", "efu_lt_albumin",
  "efu_lt_inr", "efu_90_scr", "efu_90_readmit", "efu_90lt_scr", "efu_180_scr",
  "efu_180_readmit", "efu_180lt_scr", "efu_1yr_scr", "efu_1yr_readmit",
  "efu_1yrlt_scr"
)

efu_raw <- list.files(efu_dir, pattern = "_09092026\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE) %>%
  set_names(~ str_remove(basename(.x), "_09092026\\.csv$")) %>%
  map_dfr(
    ~ read_csv(.x, col_types = cols(.default = col_character()), show_col_types = FALSE),
    .id = "efu_center"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    id_key = norm_id(subjectid),
    across(all_of(efu_yesno), as.integer),
    # parse_number() keeps below-detection strings such as "<0.2" (-> 0.2)
    across(all_of(efu_numeric), readr::parse_number)
  ) %>%
  select(-subjectid)

master <- master %>% mutate(id_key = norm_id(subjectid))

efu_cohort <- master %>%
  inner_join(efu_raw, by = "id_key")
```

## Join QC

```{r efu-qc}
#| code-summary: "Show join QC"
qc <- tibble(
  check = c(
    "EFU rows (all site files)",
    "EFU rows matched to master",
    "EFU rows NOT in master",
    "Master patients (n)",
    "Master patients without EFU data",
    "Analytic cohort (EFU patients)"
  ),
  n = c(
    nrow(efu_raw),
    sum(efu_raw$id_key %in% master$id_key),
    sum(!efu_raw$id_key %in% master$id_key),
    nrow(master),
    sum(!master$id_key %in% efu_raw$id_key),
    nrow(efu_cohort)
  )
)
knitr::kable(qc, caption = "EFU vs master join")
```

```{r efu-qc-sites}
#| code-summary: "Show per-site join status"
bind_rows(
  efu_raw %>%
    mutate(status = if_else(id_key %in% master$id_key, "matched", "not in master")) %>%
    count(site_file = efu_center, status),
  master %>%
    filter(!id_key %in% efu_raw$id_key) %>%
    mutate(site_file = "(no EFU file)", status = "master only") %>%
    count(site_file, status)
) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = status, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Rows per site file by join status (MCX = Mayo + MCM)")
```

# Derived Variables

```{r derived}
#| code-summary: "Show derived variables"
t1_numeric <- c(
  "age", "admit_meld_3", "day0_meld_3", "baseline_scr_new", "baseline_scr",
  "tbili_admit", "inr_admit", "sodium_admit", "albumin_admit", "map_day0_avg",
  "aclf_grade", "clif_c_score", "Discont_Day", "total_albumin",
  "totalalbumin_before_terli", "albvolume_before_terli", "time_to_rrt"
)

# Post-discharge RRT fields that feed rrt_any
rrt_any_cols <- c("efu_1yrlt_rrt", "efu_1yr_rrt", "efu_180lt_rrt",
                  "efu_180_rrt", "efu_90lt_rrt", "efu_90_rrt")

efu_cohort <- efu_cohort %>%
  mutate(
    # Average of the four day-0 MAP readings. A recorded 0 mmHg is a
    # "not measured" placeholder, so it is set to NA before averaging.
    across(
      c(map_terli_day0_time0, map_terli_day0_time1,
        map_terli_day0_time2, map_terli_day0_time3),
      ~ na_if(as.numeric(.x), 0)
    ),
    map_day0_avg = rowMeans(
      across(c(map_terli_day0_time0, map_terli_day0_time1,
               map_terli_day0_time2, map_terli_day0_time3)),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    map_day0_avg = if_else(is.nan(map_day0_avg), NA_real_, map_day0_avg),
    # --- Variables defined in the 2026-11-16 request ---------------------
    # Any albumin given during terlipressin therapy.
    albumin_terli = if_else(total_albumin > 0, 1, 0),

    # Any RRT recorded at ANY post-discharge follow-up point (90 d, 180 d,
    # 1 yr; overall or post-transplant). Blank follow-up fields count as "no".
    rrt_any = if_else(
      rowSums(across(all_of(rrt_any_cols), ~ as.numeric(.x) == 1), na.rm = TRUE) > 0, 1, 0),

    # Days from terlipressin initiation (not admission) to RRT start.
    time_to_rrt = as.numeric(efu_daysrrtstart) - as.numeric(days_to_terli_initiation_day0),

    # Listed at some point but not listed at last follow-up = removed from the
    # waitlist. Anything else (including missing) counts as not removed.
    efu_removed = if_else(
      as.numeric(efu_listing) == 0 & as.numeric(efu_listingstatus) == 1, 1, 0, missing = 0),

    # ICU length of stay; one record discharges before admission, so drop it.
    icu_los = as.numeric(days_to_icu_dc) - as.numeric(days_to_icu_admit),
    icu_los = if_else(icu_los < 0, NA_real_, icu_los),

    across(all_of(t1_numeric), as.numeric)
  )

tibble(
  `map_day0_avg` = c("non-missing", "readings used per patient (median)"),
  value = c(
    sum(!is.na(efu_cohort$map_day0_avg)),
    median(rowSums(!is.na(efu_cohort[, paste0("map_terli_day0_time", 0:3)])))
  )
) %>% knitr::kable()
```

## Listing status: index hospitalization vs EFU

`listed_transplant` (shared pipeline: `lt_eval == 2 | lteval_listingstatus == 1`)
captures listing during the index hospitalization; `efu_listingstatus`
captures listing at any point through 1 year.

```{r listing-crosstab}
#| code-summary: "Show cross-tabulation"
with(efu_cohort,
     table(listed_transplant = listed_transplant,
           efu_listingstatus = efu_listingstatus, useNA = "ifany")) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Rows: listed_transplant; columns: efu_listingstatus (NA = missing)")
```

# Table 3 — HRS Reversal

Cohort: patients listed for transplant at any point (`efu_listingstatus == 1`),
**unstratified** — a single overall column, so there is no comparison and no
p-value.

```{r table3}
#| code-summary: "Show Table 3 code"
# tableone with no `strata`; same print settings as create_table_one() so the
# formatting matches the stratified tables.
create_table_one_overall <- function(all_vars, data, output,
                                     cat_vars = NULL, caption = NULL) {
  all_vars <- intersect(all_vars, names(data))
  numerical_vars <- if (is.null(cat_vars)) all_vars else setdiff(all_vars, cat_vars)

  T1 <- tableone::CreateTableOne(vars = all_vars, data = data,
                                 factorVars = cat_vars, includeNA = FALSE)
  T1_print <- print(T1, showAllLevels = TRUE, nonnormal = numerical_vars,
                    missing = TRUE, quote = FALSE, noSpaces = TRUE,
                    printToggle = FALSE)
  write.csv(T1_print, file = output, row.names = TRUE)
  knitr::kable(T1_print, caption = caption)
}

t3_vars <- c("terli_route_day0", "albumin_terli", "total_albumin",
             "hrs_responders", "hrs_responders_cat_2", "HRS_reversal_new")
t3_cat  <- setdiff(t3_vars, "total_albumin")

create_table_one_overall(
  all_vars = t3_vars,
  cat_vars = t3_cat,
  data     = t1_data %>% filter(efu_listingstatus == 1),
  output   = "tables/table3_hrs_reversal_listed.csv",
  caption  = "Table 3 - HRS reversal and treatment characteristics, patients listed for transplant (unstratified)"
)
```

# Table 4 — Factors Associated with Overall Response

Stratified by `hrs_responders_cat_2` (0 = no response, 1 = overall response =
complete + partial) in two cohorts: **4a** patients listed for transplant at
any point (`efu_listingstatus == 1`) and **4b** patients who received a liver
transplant (`efu_lt == 1`).

Three requested rows are derived rather than stored; `rrt_any` and
`time_to_rrt` use the definitions given in the 2026-11-16 request:

| Requested | Used | Why |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `icu_los` | derived | `days_to_icu_dc − days_to_icu_admit` (123 patients; one negative value set to `NA`) |
| `map_terli_day0_time{0-3}` (avg) | `map_day0_avg` | the day-0 MAP average already used in Table 1 |
| `discont_reason_terli_dayN` | `discont_reason_terli` | the shared pipeline's value taken at `Discont_Day` |

::: {.callout-warning}
## `baseline_scr_new_2` does not fit the <3 / ≥3–<5 / ≥5 cut

`baseline_scr_new_2` is the **pre-admission baseline** creatinine (median 1.11,
max 3.66 mg/dL), so the requested bands put 208 patients in `<3`, 8 in
`≥3–<5` and **0 in `≥5`** — the top band is empty and the row is effectively
binary. The table below uses the bands exactly as requested. Those thresholds
fit a peak/presenting creatinine instead: `scr_terli_day0` splits 146 / 87 / 10
and `peakhospit_scr` splits 92 / 111 / 38. Say which variable you intended and
the row can be swapped.
:::

```{r table4-derived}
#| code-summary: "Show Table 4 derived variables"
t4_data <- efu_cohort %>%
  mutate(
    # Requested bands, applied to baseline_scr_new_2 exactly as specified.
    baseline_scr_new_2_cat = cut(
      as.numeric(baseline_scr_new_2),
      breaks = c(-Inf, 3, 5, Inf), right = FALSE,
      labels = c("<3", ">=3 to <5", ">=5")
    )
  )

t4_numeric <- c(
  "day0_meld", "day0_meld_na", "day0_meld_3",
  "admit_meld", "admit_meld_na", "admit_meld_3", "admit_meld_3_raw",
  "aclf_grade", "clif_c_score", "clif_c_score_new",
  "bili_terli_day0", "inr_terli_day0", "na_terli_day0", "alb_terli_day0",
  "map_day0_avg", "time_to_rrt",
  "efu_dayslt", "efu_dayskal", "efu_daysreadmit", "efu_readmitscr",
  "efu_90_scr", "efu_90_readmit", "efu_90lt_scr",
  "efu_180_scr", "efu_180_readmit", "efu_180lt_scr",
  "efu_1yr_scr", "efu_1yr_readmit", "efu_1yrlt_scr",
  "icu_los", "days_to_discharge"
)

t4_categorical <- c(
  "baseline_scr_new_2_cat", "sex_male", "rrt_any",
  "efu_lt", "efu_slkt", "efu_kal", "efu_ltrrt",
  "efu_readmit", "efu_readmit_cirrhosiscomp", "efu_readmitaki",
  "efu_90_rrt", "efu_90lt_rrt", "efu_180_rrt", "efu_180lt_rrt",
  "efu_1yr_rrt", "efu_1yrlt_rrt",
  "discont_reason_terli", "any_ae",
  "terli_ae_abdpain", "terli_ae_nausea", "terli_ae_diarrhea",
  "terli_ae_volover", "terli_ae_brady", "terli_7", "terli_8",
  "terli_ae_respfail", "noso_infection"
)

t4_vars <- c(t4_numeric, t4_categorical)

t4_data <- t4_data %>% mutate(across(all_of(t4_numeric), as.numeric))
```
